steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: How much time do we have left?

steps.speaker: FAC
steps.content: Based on our estimates of Eastian vehicles, suspect Du Ruo could enter another state's territory in six hours.

steps.speaker: FAC
steps.content: If we can't catch up, we'll just have to wait for the higher-ups to issue a formal query.
You follow the FAC squad deep into the heart of WhiteSands. The sensation from the shackles becomes progressively clearer.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: It won't come to that. Six hours is enough.
You point the squad in a rough direction and the ship speeds ahead.
Looking out through the observation window, the vast WhiteSands stretches endlessly. You can only rely on the thermal radar to search for nearby life forms.

steps.speaker: FAC
steps.content: Look, there's something here!
The helmsman shouts in surprise, and you look over.
On the radar, a new red dot is approaching step by step toward you, until a blurry figure also appears outside the observation window.

steps.speaker: FAC
steps.content: This is...
Before you can ascertain the situation, the sand under the ship starts churning.

steps.speaker: FAC
steps.content: Quicksand?!
At this moment, your shackles give you a definite response. The shadow in front of you is not the Sinner you're sensing.
The small range of quicksand expands rapidly, drawing the sand in a hundred-meter radius toward your location like a vortex.
The wind whips up sand and stones. The severe turbulence causes malfunctions in the cabin. Lighting and instruments fail one after another while alarms blare inside the cramped cabin.

steps.speaker: FAC
steps.content: Leave the cabin, quick! Get out! Or you'll be buried by the sand...
Before the soldier can finish his sentence, the sandstorm already crashes into the cabin. You suddenly find yourself in complete darkness.
The suffocating sensation brought by the quicksand knocks you out.
You don't know how much time has passed when you finally regain consciousness.
In a daze, you realize you're lying on something hard.
A slight ache in your shoulder blades makes you turn to the side, and at the same time, you smell a familiar fragrance in the air.

The bright light is blinding, forcing you to squint. Surrounding you are the canvas of a crude tent. Against the light, you see another figure inside the tent. She's sitting beside a weathered rock stump, resting her head on her hand while fiddling with a compass.
Hearing the noise from your side, she turns her head, still wearing that same roguish smile you saw on her face when you first met.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Calling my name even when you blacked out. Do you miss me that much?

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Yeah, I was just walking home when suddenly I heard a huge noise behind me. I turned around and saw... haha... a huge ship sunken into WhiteSands. And just like that, I found you there.

options: Could you make up something more believable?

choices.text: Could you make up something more believable?

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: So, what do you want to hear? I can go along with anything. Say, I set up a trap and waited for you to jump in?
Du Ruo smiles enigmatically, leaving you somewhat puzzled.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: What do you mean by this? Be more specific.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Everything. Hacking the database, leaving DisCity early, saying those things to me next to Keylan Square. And also...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Coming back to DisCity after defeating the Apostle. Was it really just for the DisCity myth?
You struggle to sit up from the stone bed. Your palm feels a sting as it supports you on the edge of the bed. You probably injured it from falling on the ship, but you can't worry about that now.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Now is not the time for jokes. If you don't return to DisCity, diplomatic tensions may rise between DisCity and Sunsink City or even the whole Eastia.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: The FAC is versed in quicksand combat. They will soon be able to locate us. You will be taken away.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: And what if I don't let them find us?
She deliberately starts toying with the compass by her side.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: I know DisCity is technologically advanced, and I've always been curious if your technology really does have the upper hand against Eastia's mystic arts.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: What is that?

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Something that allows those soldiers to discover our coordinates but not us. Although I only know the basics, it's enough to cause a little trouble for your ship.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Come back to Eastia with me, Chief. You don't have to worry about any diplomatic crises. WhiteSands is ever so perilous. Let's just pretend you and I both went missing during the chase. Neither DisCity nor Eastia would have enough reason to confront each other.
She doesn't shy away from her plans at all now. Instead, she approaches you calmly to treat your wounds.
But as she comes closer, you instinctively move away.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You haven't answered me. Are you really here to steal DisCity's secrets?
Those hands poised to heal you hang in mid-air.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: So you still don't trust me.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Not only do I trust you, but when the council doubted the purpose of your visit, I fought for you for a chance to prove yourself. But my trust alone can't explain your unusual betrayal.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: From the initial visa application to the betrayal now, I no longer know when to trust you.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You took me here and made DisCity believe I'm dead, and then? Are you going to take me to Eastia just like you said that day next to Keylan Square? And after that, what do you plan to do? Force me to spill the truth about the Black Rings?
Listening to your questions, her smile grows increasingly cold.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Don't trouble yourself to tell me about the Black Rings. I saw everything after hacking the database.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: I saw everything about BR-002, BR-001, and BR-004. Saw how you were deceived, tested, used, and even abandoned.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: But in the end, you still doubt me for the city that did all that to you.
Du Ruo smiles bitterly and takes a deep breath, her lips forming a tight line.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: The reason why I came back, why I went on that visit with you and got shackled, why I hacked the database, why I left early to set up this complicated trap in WhiteSands... You really...

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: You really don't know?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You should know full well that DisCity will not let you in its border again.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: That's why I'm not seeking DisCity's opinion. I specifically volunteered for an evaluation by the MBCC's Chief, ${PlayerName}.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: ...Didn't you want me to come back?

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Will you join me in writing this DisCity myth? I'm sure you're a highly anticipated character in this story.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: ...Do your fellow townspeople like this sort of thing?

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Sure. I, for one, do. Give me a chance to write you into this story. Will you indulge me just for once?

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: ...It's a pity that I have to leave soon and won't get to see the fully restored statue.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Next time, I'd like to bring a tea table and a good teapot. We'll each have a cup, watching the moon and Keylan over the tea till the sun rises.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: In that case, why don't I abduct you back to Eastia?

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: There's no Statue of Keylan or neon-lit skyscrapers, but Goldionville's lion dance and Sunsink City's tea ceremony are worth checking out.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Huh? So all of this was for...

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: I wish you could have seen through my intentions as easily as you did those inconsequential lies.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Then I wouldn't have had to personally verify your situation in the database.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: The hacking of the database, that was for me too?
You feel somewhat incredulous. The situation is a mess, and your wrist throbs with dull pain. Your silence prompts Du Ruo to come closer.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Let me check the wound on your wrist first.
She sits beside you, takes out a small bottle of ointment, and dips her fingertip in it, her motions as gentle as her tone.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Come with me to Eastia, Chief.

The sandstorm continues, the wind constantly hitting the shelter's canvas. Some time has passed since Eastia's recent espionage against DisCity, and the prime suspect is sitting right in front of you, the concern in her eyes genuine.
Just as you're unsure how to begin...
Suddenly, you feel a familiar throbbing in your palm.
You can clearly sense that the throbbing isn't just from one set of shackles, and it comes from a distance... You're certain this sensation isn't from Du Ruo.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: C-H-I-E-F!!!

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Shhh. There's nothing here either... Could something really have happened?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hey, don't just poke around aimlessly. It's easy to get lost in WhiteSands! ****, Nightmare, keep an eye on them!

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: Giving us all this trouble again... If he dares end up in any accident, I, I won't forgive him easily.
steps.female_content: Giving us all this trouble again... If she dares end up in any accident, I, I won't forgive her easily.

steps.speaker: Kelvin
steps.content: Nothing will happen to Chief. Maybe it's just a loss of signal? I believe in Chief, and I believe we'll find Chief.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: The location should be around here. The device is working normally.

steps.speaker: FAC
steps.content: Good, I'll send people to continue the search.
The scalding heat of the shackles and the coolness of Du Ruo's medicinal herbs intermingle to give an unexpected calming effect.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Du Ruo, can I ask you a question?
The question comes abruptly. She looks up in surprise.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Say your birthplace couldn't provide you with shelter or leave you with any fond memories, and you met friends like Xu whom you fought and grew together elsewhere. In this case, where would you consider your hometown?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Or let me put it another way. When both places needed you, how would you choose?
She pauses the moment the answer is about to slip out.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Maybe you misunderstood why I did what I did for DisCity.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Just as a myth may not be about gods, a hometown means more than just the name of a place.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: What really lies behind that... You were the one who taught me this.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: ...It's the reality built by people.
Du Ruo understands at last. She applies the last bit of ointment on you and stands up to pick up the compass.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: It seems you've made your choice.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Like I've said, there's plenty of trouble to deal with at the Bureau. I need to go back.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Wherever they are, I will be there.

options: I want to stay in DisCity.

choices.text: I want to stay in DisCity.

steps.content: You and Du Ruo lock eyes, neither of you looking away. After a long while, Du Ruo sighs deeply.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: I don't agree with your choice.
She raises her hand to the compass, her fingertips moving the pointer.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: But I respect a friend's judgment.
The compass starts spinning rapidly. After dozens of turns, it comes to a complete stop. The faint glow on the disc fades away.
At the same moment, the shelter's invisible barrier is shattered by the Nightmare. The FAC soldiers and the MBCC guards arrive together.
The Sinners also rush toward you, standing before you protectively, responding to the call of the shackles.
The FAC soldiers raise their guns and encircle Du Ruo. Her gaze sweeps over the rows of gun barrels, calm as usual.
Before the soldiers act, she speaks first.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Thanks to Chief's selfless rescue, I was able to escape from the sandstorm.

steps.speaker: FAC
steps.content: No one asked about that. Do you have nothing to say about the hacking of the database?

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: I came all this way in pursuit of the Eastian traitor who stole the data. So the FAC hasn't caught it either?
The FAC soldiers are somewhat confused by her diversion. Indifferent to their reaction, Du Ruo smiles, her gaze traveling through the crowd to you.

options: Go along with her final lie

choices.text: Go along with her final lie

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I can vouch for Du Ruo. WhiteSands is fraught with danger...

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Come back to Eastia with me, Chief. You don't have to worry about any diplomatic crises. WhiteSands is ever so perilous. Let's just pretend you and I both went missing during the chase. Neither DisCity nor Eastia would have enough reason to confront each other.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: The traitor who hacked the database went missing during the chase.
